path.label: From a local path
path.python:
from quantion import parse_ion

file = parse_ion("sample.ion")
print(file)

url.label: From a URL
url.python:
from quantion import parse_ion

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phenological/ion-files/main/data/aa_p21_LTR_20_b1_w20.ion"
file = parse_ion(url)
print(file)

bytes.label: From bytes
bytes.python:
from urllib.request import urlopen
from quantion import parse_ion

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phenological/ion-files/main/data/aa_p21_LTR_20_b1_w20.ion"
data = urlopen(url).read()
file = parse_ion(data)
print(file)
bytes.r:
library(quantion)

url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phenological/ion-files/main/data/aa_p21_LTR_20_b1_w20.ion"
data <- curl::curl_fetch_memory(url)$content
sample <- parse_ion(data)
print(sample)

refused.url: `parse_mzml` does not read URLs: it needs the whole file, so give it a path or bytes.

path.label: From a local path
path.python:
from quantion import parse_mzml

file = parse_mzml("sample.mzML")
print(file)

bytes.label: From bytes
bytes.python:
from quantion import parse_mzml

with open("sample.mzML", "rb") as handle:
    data = handle.read()
file = parse_mzml(data)
print(file)
bytes.r:
library(quantion)

data <- readBin("sample.mzML", what = "raw", n = file.size("sample.mzML"))
sample <- parse_mzml(data)
print(sample)
